title: Hazel Listings in an Article
question: How can an article show Hazel listings in Hazel's own editor, with go to definition between listings? Matthew, 2026-11-06.
measurements: None timed. Checked in a browser on 2026-11-06 from a local port: listings start one at a time and take their height once drawn; a go to definition across listings reveals the definition and scrolls to it. The demo program run in Node with hazeljs 0.0.4: 9.14159.
